categories.name: Reinforcement Learning Enhancements
categories.description: Methods that augment RL frameworks with additional signals such as multi-perspective information, anticipation embeddings, or trajectory sampling.

categories.name: Context Subgraph Enrichment with Adaptive Repair
categories.description: Proposed approach: enriching triple supervision with local context subgraphs from source passages and applying an adaptive repair loop before RL optimization.

categories.name: Embedding-based Relational Chain Integration
categories.description: Integrates explicit relational chains from questions and implicit chains from the knowledge graph via embedding modules.

categories.name: Language Model + Knowledge Graph Embedding Fusion
categories.description: Combines language model representations with knowledge graph embeddings to mitigate missing links and fuse semantic and structural information.

categories.name: Question Decomposition to SPARQL
categories.description: Parses complex questions into simpler sub-questions, converts them to SPARQL queries, and executes them over the KG.

idea_position: Context Subgraph Enrichment with Adaptive Repair
common_assumptions: Knowledge graph embeddings can effectively capture missing link information.
Language models can accurately capture the contextual meaning of questions.
Reinforcement learning frameworks can integrate additional perspective or embedding signals to improve policy learning.
Generated reasoning trajectories from LLMs capture valid reasoning paths for supervised learning.
Explicit relational chains from questions and implicit chains from the KG are complementary and can be jointly utilized.
Source passages contain sufficient triples to construct meaningful local context subgraphs around target triples/paths.
An adaptive repair loop can reliably detect one-hop prediction failures and generate useful corrective examples.
Reinforcement learning on lower-hop QA instances transfers to improved performance on higher-hop queries.

repeated_limitations.description: Reliance on external large models (e.g., GPT-4) for trajectory sampling or prompt engineering may limit accessibility and reproducibility.
Limited discussion of limitations, computational cost, or generalizability to other knowledge graphs or languages.
Dependence on high-quality few-shot datasets or handcrafted templates for effective performance.

underexplored_combinations: Combining context subgraph enrichment with explicit/implicit relational chain integration to leverage both contextual and structural signals.
Integrating adaptive repair loops with question decomposition approaches to improve SPARQL generation fidelity.
Applying reinforcement learning transfer across different KG domains (e.g., from biomedical to general KGQA) after context enrichment and repair.
